text: I watched 3 YouTube videos to see if this was something I wanted to tackle. I also read reviews of the product itself. I agree with the videos and the reviews in 2 main areas: have another person help replace the gasket and BUY the spring tension release tool. Totally worth the $15. The extra set of hands was needed to keep the gasket and the springs from popping off while fastening them onto the tub rim. The tool was necessary because of the small area the rear spring is in. Watch the videos to see how to disassemble the machine to access the gasket and for helpful hints. Overall, I would attempt this again...with another person helping and the tool.

Perfect cold water inlet replacement for my LG WM3360HVCA front load wag machine. The part I received (from Third Party seller) appeared to be an original LG part and was a perfect match. I was getting an "I.E." Inlet Error message that kept stopping my wash machine between cycles. Meaning the load never finished without constantly supervising the washing and hitting the start button every time the error flashed. I replaced both this cold water inlet and the 5220FR2006H hot water inlet at the same time and the machine runs like new again with no interruptions. Very happy with this inexpensive and simple DIY fix.

Just unscrew the top to the wash machine, remove cover. Turn off water supply and unscrew water supply hoses, then unscrew old inlets, take off rubber hoses and electrical clips to the old part and then reattach to the new part. Be sure all hoses are secure or it may leak when you run the machine again.
